title.narrative: ACTION - Accelerating key net zero technologies by leveraging industrial decarbonisation investment

description.narrative: The ACTION project in Brazil aims to revolutionize agriculture with Carbon-Negative Organo-Mineral Fertilizers (CNOMF) made from waste, supporting Brazil's commitment to sustainable and low-carbon farming under the National Plan for Low Carbon Emission in Agriculture (ABC Plan) and the National Fertilizer Plan. This initiative focuses on reducing carbon footprints and enhancing productivity in the chemical and agriculture sectors by introducing sustainable practices. Indirectly, it boosts renewable energy through biogas development and improves waste management by diverting waste from landfills, significantly cutting GHG emissions. Over 66 months, ACTION plans to establish 18 production units across three scales, projecting a reduction of 45,296,848 tCO2e. The project integrates policy, technology, and market strategies to foster sustainable growth in agriculture and related sectors, aiming for a transformative impact on Brazil's agricultural landscape.
